# ContextFS 0.1.3

Homebrew now lives in the shared **`derek-x-wang/tap`**. ContextFS moved off its
own per-project tap (`derek-x-wang/ctxfs`) into the consolidated tap that serves
all of Derek's tools, so a single `brew tap` covers everything.

## What's new

- **Single shared Homebrew tap.** The cask and CLI formula are now published to
  `github.com/Derek-X-Wang/homebrew-tap` (standard `Casks/` + `Formula/`
  layout) instead of the standalone `homebrew-ctxfs` tap. The release pipeline
  pushes `contextfs.rb` directly to the tap's `main`, matching how the other
  tools on that tap publish.
- **No functional changes to the app or CLI.** This is an infrastructure /
  distribution release; the binary and `ContextFS.app` are unchanged from 0.1.2
  apart from the version bump.

## Install

**Mac app (recommended)**:

```bash
brew install --cask derek-x-wang/tap/contextfs
```

**CLI only**:

```bash
brew install derek-x-wang/tap/contextfs
```

### Already tapped the old `derek-x-wang/ctxfs`?

Re-point to the shared tap once:

```bash
brew untap derek-x-wang/ctxfs
brew tap derek-x-wang/tap
```

Existing installs keep working and update normally over Sparkle; the tap change
only affects fresh `brew install` / `brew upgrade` resolution.

## Requirements

- macOS 26.0 or later (FSKit backend)
- macOS 15.4 or later (NFS backend fallback)
- Apple Silicon or Intel Mac
